changes: 新增手部横向开距软惩罚，降低难发力的大横拉姿态
新增脚部横向开距软惩罚，抑制双脚过度横向展开
新增双脚上下高差软惩罚与硬红线，减少脚步垂直跨度过大
新增低位脚点优先决策：存在更低且稳定的候选脚点时，不直接踩更高脚点
新增补低脚上提奖励，鼓励先提升稳定性再继续向上
reason: 手脚横向距离过大导致难以发力，需要扣分并抑制
脚上下跨度过大会降低稳定性，需要限制
若可踩低位确定脚点，应优先踩低位点提升高度与稳定性

changes: 将新增岩点的配额判定从软惩罚改为硬约束：当某类型剩余配额<=0时直接跳过该子节点
新增完攀返回前的最终配额兜底校验：若最终路线任一类型超额则丢弃该完攀状态并继续搜索
抽取 get_quota_violations 统一统计逻辑，避免成功/部分成功分支口径不一致
reason: 此前实现允许“超额但加罚分”的路径继续扩展，导致最终返回路线可能超出配方数量
业务要求为“岩点数绝对不能超额”，因此配额必须是不可绕过的硬性约束
在返回前增加兜底可防止边界路径漏检，保证输出路线严格合法

changes: 新增候选路线签名去重逻辑，避免同一条候选被重复包装成两条最终路线
新增候选路线差异化筛选（Jaccard 重叠率阈值），优先返回动作结构差异明显的第二条路线
当不存在足够差异的第二候选时，降级为仅返回1条，避免重复输出
新增手脚过近软惩罚，抑制手脚抱团导致的压缩姿态
新增同侧手脚堆叠惩罚（LH-LF / RH-RF），减少局部拥挤影响蹬伸
新增双脚过窄站位惩罚，降低不利于发力的窄站姿
reason: 用户反馈最终返回的两块岩板完全一致，根因是结果选择阶段未做去重与差异性约束
用户反馈手脚过近不利于发力，需要在代价函数中显式惩罚压缩位形
通过差异化输出与姿态惩罚，可同时提升路线多样性与可攀性

changes: 新增脚步对侧高踩强拦截（含同列/近列上方高踩）以阻断身体过横动作
升级低位脚点优先策略：引入身体中线与左右脚自然站位偏好，优先中线稳定过渡脚点
新增身体扭转惩罚（手脚中轴偏移、脚点近列高差）并并入稳定性代价函数
新增后验 Beta 平衡校验 validate_beta_balance，并在候选入池前执行过滤
reason: 用户反馈左脚存在更优中间踩点时，算法仍会踩向右脚上方点，导致骨盆偏转与发力变差
仅靠脚点高低优先不足以约束身体朝向，需要引入中线与同侧脚步规则
在求解与后验两层同时加约束，可降低漏检并稳定抑制过横姿态

changes: 新增两点压缩姿态识别：仅在 LH==RH 且 LF==RF（且手脚分离）时判定为双双 match
新增两点压缩软惩罚：对中段双双 match 高额加罚，起步阶段仅轻惩罚，顶点双手 match 免罚
新增脱离两点压缩态奖励：若动作使状态从双双 match 恢复到>=3点支撑则给予奖励
reason: 用户反馈双手双脚总共只占两个点会导致站不稳，需要精准压制该姿态
不能一刀切禁止双手同点或双脚同点，否则会误伤正常动作并降低完攀成功率
采用中段强惩罚+恢复奖励的软引导方式，可在保持成线率的同时降低不稳定姿态出现概率

changes: 新增 MAX_FOOT_MOVE_VERTICAL_DELTA=4 动作级硬约束
在 A* 子节点扩展阶段新增脚步单次上提拦截：当 target_y-current_y > 4 时直接跳过该候选
reason: 用户要求脚在移动时垂直跨度不能超过4格
通过搜索阶段硬拦截可避免产生超跨度脚步动作，同时保留多步连续提脚的可行上升路径

changes: Separated fixed 11x18 board setup from route overlay for the standard-board module
Loaded backend/data/mock_holds.json as the 198-hold board_setup instead of synthesizing route-only holds
Made default standard-board queries return only valid_for_climb routes
Updated standard-board validation to require explicit start roles, at least two starts, at least one high end, 6-12 holds, Y1-Y5 starts, and no narrow ladder routes
Constrained generation to valid routes and mid-hold mutation while preserving start and end holds
reason: The standard board should render as a full fixed setup with only selected route coordinates highlighted
Imported raw routes without explicit starts or with impossible geometry were polluting the default library and generated results
Start holds at Y5 should remain valid when the source role is explicit

changes: Replaced mock_holds.json standard-board setup generation with the 8 user-recorded hold variants from holds_mapping.json
Added imageUrl/svgPath fields to Hold so the standard-board API can return recorded hold images directly
Standard-board setup now fills all A1-K18 coordinates with fixed scale 0.78 and deterministic rotations
BoardCanvas now prefers recorded PNG images over SVG paths when rendering holds
Standard-board preview constrains setup hold images to a uniform visual size and uses a wood-board background
reason: The user requested recorded hold assets instead of automatic SVG hold shapes
Uniform sizing and deterministic rotation make the board read like a real fixed training board without visual overlap
Using the recorded 8-hold pool keeps the setup visually consistent with the user's own asset library

changes: Added non-destructive processing for recorded hold PNGs by removing border-connected white background pixels into holds_images_processed
Mounted processed hold images at /processed-images and made standard-board setup prefer those URLs
Replaced the 0/90/180/270 setup rotation cycle with deterministic 0-359 degree coordinate-based rotations
Added tests for processed image transparency, processed image URL usage, and broad rotation coverage
reason: Recorded hold images had opaque white border/background pixels that looked poor on the wood board
The original assets should remain untouched so the processed transparent images are reversible cache artifacts
A real fixed training board should show varied orientations, not only quarter-turn rotations

changes: Replaced the previous semi-transparent border cleanup with GrabCut foreground extraction
Changed processed hold output to cutout_v3 files so the standard-board module no longer reuses damaged cached images
Cropped processed images to the foreground and added transparent safety padding around each hold
Strengthened tests so processed image borders must have zero non-transparent pixels
reason: The previous halo cleanup left semi-transparent rectangular image bounds that became visible after arbitrary rotation
Standard-board holds need fully transparent outer borders to avoid rotated square artifacts
Versioned processed images prevent stale broken cache files from remaining in use

changes: Changed standard-board setup image URLs back to original recorded /images assets
Stopped the standard-board preview from automatically using processed/cutout images as the primary hold source
Kept deterministic 0-359 degree setup rotations while applying them to intact original hold images
Added non-destructive CSS blending for standard-board setup images to reduce white-background visibility
Updated tests to assert standard-board setup uses original image URLs
reason: Processed cutout images could display as damaged or incomplete holds on the board
The first priority is complete, recognizable hold rendering; white-background cleanup must not damage the source visual
CSS blending is reversible and does not mutate uploaded hold assets
